app.title: AZRAS Evaluation
app.subtitle: Integrated Building Life-Cycle Analysis Platform
module1: Module 1: Drawing, Quantity and Building Performance Analysis
warning_provisional: Drawing recognition, average unit factors and thermal-performance values are provisional planning-comparison values. Replace them with verified drawings, specifications, structural calculations, equipment schedules and professional review for formal design.
select_project: Save a project in Module 0 first, or select a project JSON file.
other_equipment_electricity: Lighting, Plug Loads, Ventilation, Refrigerator, etc.
floor_area_intensity: Annual Electricity per Gross Floor Area
module1_required: Select a project JSON containing Module 1 output.
weather_required: Select an EPW or 8760-hour CSV file.
profile_notice: Regional values are initial templates. Update them using current official or utility-specific data.
model_notice: This is a planning-comparison calculation using a reduced three-node thermal model. It does not replace detailed tools such as EnergyPlus, BEST or THERB.
module3: Module 3: Repair, Renewal and Demolition Scenario
same_use_scale: Keep the Same Use and Scale after Rebuild
layout_adaptive: Change Layout with Future Demand and Social Conditions
layout_accessibility: Renew for Accessibility and Ageing Society
scenario_notice: This scenario does not calculate cost. It passes work scope, retained components, removals, reuse and recycling targets to Modules 4 and 7.
scenario_provisional: Initial cycles are planning-comparison values. Revise them using actual deterioration, inspections, disasters, regulations, manufacturer data and maintenance records.
module1_required_m3: Select a project JSON containing Module 1 output.
same_use_scale_note: After rebuilding, use and scale remain the same, while layout, equipment and performance specifications are updated for future conditions.
include_biogenic: Show reference biogenic carbon storage for timber and CLT
initial_embodied_co2: Initial Material, Construction and Transport CO₂
co2_intensity_life: Net CO₂ per Floor Area and Year
energy_intensity_life: Total Energy per Floor Area and Year
lca_factor_notice: Environmental factors are planning-comparison defaults. For formal assessment, replace them with regional data, product EPDs and verified transport, construction and waste-treatment data.
module123_required: Select a project JSON containing Module 1, Module 2 and Module 3 outputs.
system_boundary_notice: This module is a planning-comparison life-cycle aggregation. It does not replace certified LCA, product EPDs, statutory energy calculations or detailed simulation.
cost_per_m2: Construction Cost per Gross Floor Area
cost_notice: Standard construction assumes level surroundings, no obstacles, adequate working space and suitable delivery access. HVAC, electrical, plumbing and sanitary systems, kitchens and bathrooms are not included in the quantity-based standard construction cost; add them as lump-sum equipment costs when required. Related trade labor is included in each equipment-package price and is not counted twice.
unit_cost_notice: Unit costs are for planning comparison. Update them using current cost references and quotations for the relevant region, date and specification. Overseas costs remain in local currency; no foreign-exchange conversion is applied.
module1_required_m5: Select a project JSON containing Module 1 output.
annual_rent_per_m2: Annual Rent per Gross Floor Area
property_tax_rate: Property Tax etc. (% of Construction Cost)
irr_unlevered: Project Internal Rate of Return (IRR, Unlevered)
investment_notice: Module 6 uses Module 5 construction cost to assess feasibility over the selected assessment period, including rent, vacancy, operations, maintenance, taxes, insurance, financing and terminal value. Future repair and rebuild costs from Module 3 are not yet included; Modules 7 and 8 will integrate them.
investment_assumption_notice: Market rent, vacancy, interest, tax and terminal capitalization rates are planning-comparison assumptions. Replace them with verified market, lender, tax and valuation data.
module5_required_m6: Select a project JSON containing Module 5 output.
not_recovered: Not recovered within the assessment period
calculate_repair_cost: Calculate Repair, Renewal and Demolition Costs
repair_cost_notice: Uses the Module 3 scenario and Module 5 construction cost to estimate repairs, renewals, partial demolition and full rebuilds.
module35_required: Module 3 and Module 5 outputs are required.
total_lifecycle_work_cost: Total Repair, Renewal, Demolition and Rebuild Cost
cost_per_m2_year: Cost per Floor Area and Year
summary_total_cost: Total Repair, Renewal, Demolition and Rebuild Cost
summary_cost_m2_year: Cost per Floor Area and Year
module8_notice: Integrates Construction Cost and Repair/Renewal/Demolition Cost to calculate years 1–100 and 101–200.
module8_assumption_notice: This assessment is for planning comparison. Replace assumptions with verified project data.
module67_required: Select a project JSON containing Module 6 and Module 7 outputs.
business_property_tax: Property Tax etc. (% of Initial Investment)
include_module7_costs: Include Module 7 Repair, Renewal, Demolition and Rebuild Costs
total_module7_cost: Cumulative Repair, Renewal, Demolition and Rebuild Cost
annual_module7_cost: Repair, Renewal, Demolition and Rebuild Cost
three_storey_separate: Three Storeys or More Require Separate Assessment
module9_notice: The initial release implements flood scenarios. Tsunami, earthquake, fire, wind/tornado and landslide scenarios are in preparation.
module9_assumption_notice: Recovery cost, duration, waste, CO₂, energy and insurance eligibility are initial planning estimates. Replace them with post-disaster surveys, structural safety checks, equipment inspections, policy terms, quotations and regulatory review.
module9_scope_notice: The platform primarily targets two-storey residential, retail, office, warehouse and factory buildings. Buildings of three storeys or more require separate assessment.
disaster_not_implemented: The selected disaster is in preparation. Only flood scenarios are currently available.
location_apply_notice: Retrieves latitude and longitude from country, city and address, then writes them to the common Project JSON location data.
location_manual_notice: If automatic retrieval is unavailable, latitude and longitude may be entered manually and saved.
reverse_geocoding_complete: Location details retrieved from the coordinates.
invalid_coordinates: Latitude or longitude has an invalid format.
coordinates_range_error: Latitude must be between -90 and 90, and longitude between -180 and 180.
project_number_notice: The internal ID is generated automatically. An AZRAS management number may also be generated.
clipboard_notice: All input and display fields support copy, paste, cut and select-all. Right-click tables to copy a cell, selected rows or the entire table.
location_mismatch_rejected: The candidate does not match the entered state/prefecture and municipality. It was not applied.
coordinate_settings: Latitude and Longitude for Climate / Regional Assessment
google_maps_coordinate_notice: The address is retained for project management. Climate, EPW and regional factors use coordinates verified in Google Maps.
coordinate_usage_notice: The original Google Maps coordinates remain in the yellow field. Press Paste Google Coordinates to show the rounded AZRAS latitude and longitude below.
invalid_coordinate_pair: Enter two numbers in the order latitude, longitude.
coordinates_propagated: Coordinates were saved to the Project JSON and applied as the common coordinates for Modules 0–9.
legend_equipment_title: Module 1: Legend Learning and Equipment Symbol Reading
legend_equipment_notice: Draw a rectangle around a symbol in the drawing legend, select its equipment type, and register it. AZRAS searches the drawing for matching symbols and totals the quantity.
select_symbol_rectangle: Draw a rectangle around an equipment symbol in the legend.
register_legend_first: Register at least one legend symbol.
equipment_counts_applied: Recognized quantities were applied to the Module 1 equipment fields.
save_conditions_missing: Check the Project JSON, calculation result and save path.
project_json_update_rule: Specify the save location only once when creating or loading the project in Module 0. Update Save in Modules 1–9 overwrites the same Project JSON currently selected in Module 0.
legend_equipment_notice_v927: All PDF pages are available. Register legend symbols, then draw blue search regions on each equipment drawing. Different fixtures within the same category can be named and counted separately.
select_drawing_rectangle: Press Select Drawing Region and draw around the equipment drawing area.
drawing_area_required: No equipment search region is registered on pages:
mode_symbol: Legend-symbol selection mode. Draw around the symbol only.
mode_region: Equipment-drawing region mode. Draw around the area to be searched.
legend_region_matching: Legend symbol matched inside registered drawing regions
mode_symbol_status: Current mode: Select a legend symbol (red rectangle)
mode_region_status: Current mode: Select an equipment drawing search region (blue rectangle)
select_project_country_first: Select a country in Module 0 and save the Project JSON first.
weather_files_registered: Weather data was registered in the country catalog.
weather_country_mismatch: Some EPW files contain a country different from the Project JSON. They were registered under the country stored in the EPW file.
country_selection_notice: Country is selected from a list and shared with Modules 1–9 through the Project JSON.
shared_project_notice: Select the Project JSON in Module 0. Modules 1–9 automatically use the same file.
no_shared_project: Load or save a Project JSON in Module 0 before opening this module.
manual_weather_fallback: Use weather registration or direct selection only when automatic retrieval is unavailable.
coordinates_required_for_weather: Apply latitude and longitude in Module 0 and save the Project JSON.
weather_catalog_searching: Searching for the nearest EnergyPlus weather station from the project coordinates.
existing_weather_file_in_use: Using the weather file already saved for this project.
coordinates_not_found_in_project: No valid latitude and longitude were found in the Project JSON. Apply the coordinates in Module 0 and save.
saved_environment_result_restored: The weather file, environmental settings and saved calculation results were restored from the Project JSON.
module6_module5_missing: The Module 5 construction-cost result has not been saved in the Project JSON. Calculate Module 5 first and press Update and Save Project JSON.
module6_module5_invalid: The Module 5 total construction cost is zero or invalid. Check quantities, unit costs and construction-cost conditions, then save Module 5 again.
module6_unexpected_error:
An unexpected error occurred during the Module 6 calculation.
{error}
irr_not_available_note: IRR is shown as “–” when the cash flow has no valid sign change.
module8_no_project: Load a Project JSON in Module 0.
module8_module6_missing: The Module 6 investment evaluation result is not saved in the Project JSON. Calculate Module 6 and press Update and Save Project JSON.
module8_module7_missing: Module 7 costs are enabled, but the Module 7 result has not been saved. Calculate and save Module 7 first, or clear the checkbox.
module8_unexpected_error:
An unexpected error occurred during the Module 8 calculation.
{error}
module9_floor_area_missing: Calculate the storeys, floor areas and gross floor area in Module 1, then update and save the Project JSON.
module9_affected_area_notice: For flood depth up to GL +2.5 m, the first-floor area is used. Above GL +2.5 m, the combined first- and second-floor area is used.
module8_save_verification_failed: Module 8 save verification failed. The result was not written to the Project JSON.
pv_model_notice: PV generation uses horizontal global solar radiation from the EPW for planning comparison. Verify roof tilt, azimuth, detailed shading, module temperature, snow, dirt and degradation during detailed design.
final_check.title: Final Module Verification
final_check.notice: This verification does not modify the original Project JSON. Save-and-reload tests use a temporary copy. WARNING indicates uncalculated modules or moved external files; ERROR indicates missing links or required values.
final_check.load_first: Please load the Project JSON in Module 0 before running verification.
final_check.no_critical_error: No critical errors were found. Please review the WARNING items.
module8_split_storage_notice: For reliable saving, the 200 annual rows are separated into two CSV files: years 1–100 and years 101–200. The Project JSON stores only summary values and CSV references.
business_complete_split_saved: The 200-year business cash flow was calculated and saved to two CSV files and the Project JSON.
module8_external_csv_warning:
The annual cash-flow CSV files could not be loaded.
{error}
module8_split_save_verification_failed: Module 8 split-save verification failed. Check the years 1–100 and years 101–200 CSV files.
biogenic_storage_per_area: CO₂ Storage per Gross Floor Area
net_lifecycle_after_biogenic_reference: Life-Cycle CO₂ after Reference Storage Deduction
mode_lite_notice: Lite Mode: complete a rapid assessment using the established workflow.
mode_pro_notice: Professional Mode: detailed design, quantity, cost and long-term business assessment through Modules 1–7.
mode_selection_notice: Select the startup mode. Lite provides the established rapid workflow; Professional adds detailed structure, method and assembly configuration.
mode_lite_description: Uses Modules 0–9 for rapid PDF analysis, quantities, performance, CO₂, energy, construction cost and 100/200-year assessment.
mode_pro_description: Professional workflow using one combined PDF containing detailed plans, wall sections, partial details, structural and services drawings.
lite_footer_notice: Lite JSON files can be compared in Integrated_Comparison using the simplified set.
pro_footer_notice: Combine all detailed drawings into one PDF. Missing drawings are supplemented as clearly labelled AI planning estimates with provenance and confidence.
mode_save_warning:
The selected mode could not be saved to the active Project JSON.
{error}
business_annual_rent_per_m2: Annual Rent per Gross Floor Area
module8_module5_missing: Calculate and save Construction Cost first.
pro_module1: Module 1: Detailed Structure, Method and Assemblies
pro_module2: Module 2: Detailed Drawings, Quantities and Performance
pro_module6: Module 6: Repair, Renewal and Demolition Cost
pro_module10: Module 10: Regional CO₂, Energy and Suitability Comparison
lite_module9: Module 9: Regional Independent Project JSON Generator
equipment_per_dwelling_note: Each rated capacity is entered per dwelling. Whole-building capacity and annual energy are calculated as rated capacity × target dwellings × annual operating hours × load factor ÷ efficiency/COP.
app.subtitle_v4: Building Digital Twin / Lifecycle Analysis Platform
future_climate_notice: Re-runs the dynamic model after applying the specified temperature offset to all 8760 hours of the same EPW. Humidity, solar radiation, wind, cloud and extremes are unchanged; this is a planning sensitivity, not a formal future-weather prediction.
grid_scenario_notice: Low -0.25%/yr | Standard -0.50%/yr | High -1.00%/yr | Custom. Standard preserves the prior value; these are sensitivities, not forecasts.
lca_module_crosswalk_notice: Maps existing AZRAS totals to explanatory A1-A5 / B / C / D groups. It does not newly resolve A1/A2/A3/A4/A5 or C1/C2/C3/C4.
